name: Nakajima Narumi
source:
She is Kazuko's older sister and a kogal.

She lives with her parents and Kazuko. She knows about Yuki and Junpei. She and Kazuko don't get along well, but for some reason she seems to get along well with Yuki.

She wears a miniskirt and loose-fitting socks. Her breasts are smaller than Maki's.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bokumitsu.html]official site[/url]]
